selected_section_text: DAO. The Switch Atlas and Operator Lift Compiler Through line The Conductor Branch DAN found the Wiles move the residual conductor representation of \(\mathfrak{su}(2)_k\) splits exactly at \(k=4\). DAO makes the switch executable : a detector that reads the residual, names the closure, and dispatches. T he comparison language is corrected first, so the result survives scrutiny. From the modular datum \((S,T)\) one builds the generated operator algebra \(A_{\mathrm{cond}}=\langle S,T\rangle\); the commutant \(A_{\mathrm{cond}}'=\mathrm{End}_{SL(2,\mathbb{Z})}(V)\), which reads multiplicities and block structure; and the bicommutant \(A_{\mathrm{cond}}''\), which closes back to \(A_{\mathrm{cond}}\) when the residual is semisimple. The finite criterion is not the commutant equals the Hecke algebra it is the Wedderburn identity \(\dim A_{\mathrm{cond}}=\sum_i n_i^2\) together with \(\dim A_{\mathrm{cond}}'=\#\text{blocks}\). The symbol \(R_{\mathrm{cond}}\) is reserved for the future deformation functor, not the commutant. This is matched dimensions, not yet a ring level isomorphism. Figure 149. The switch atlas. For each \(\mathfrak{su}(2)_k\) the detector builds \(A_{\mathrm{cond}}=\langle S,T\rangle\), reads block structure from the commutant \(A_{\mathrm{cond}}'\), and verifies \(\dim A_{\mathrm{cond}}=\sum_i n_i^2\). It reproduces the DAN table from first principles and lands the unique reducible residual at \(k=4=SO(3)_2\), the property\(-F\) object, dispatching \(\mathcal B_X\to\mathcal M_X\). Computed from tqc.switch_atlas . DAO The Switch Is Executable Verified The detector reproduces the DAN \(\mathfrak{su}(2)_k\) table from first principles \(N=(24,16,40,24,56)\), \(\dim A_{\mathrm{cond}}=(4,9,16,13,36)\), \(\dim A_{\mathrm{cond}}'=(1,1,1,2,1)\) with the Wedderburn identity holding and the bicommutant closing throughout. The unique reducible residual is \(k=4\) (\(5=2\oplus3\), \(13=4+9\)), which is \(SO(3)_2\), the property\(-F\) object; it dispatches \(\mathcal B_X\to\mathcal M_X\) while every irreducible case stays in \(\mathcal B_X\). Finite braid image is not failure but a residual diagnostic: the reducible case is the signal to switch to adaptive measurement closure a representation theoretic decision rule, not an engineering rescue. Verified: the \((S,T)\) construction; \(\dim A_{\mathrm{cond}}\) and \(\dim A_{\mathrm{cond}}'\) by linear algebra; the Wedderburn identity; the bicommutant equality; the full DAN table; the unique \(k=4\) switch; the \(\mathcal B_X/\mathcal M_X\) dispatch exact numeric, backend free. Imported: \(\mathcal M_X\) supplies universality for \(SO(3)_2\). Warrant: \(\texttt{switch\_atlas}\) ( dbba9309b274e91f ), verdict true . Obstruction ledger: \(H^1(G,\mathrm{ad}\,\rho)=0\) by Maschke (rigid; Selmer trivial), genuine obstruction in \([\omega]\in H^3(G,U(1))\). OPEN: ring level \(R=T\); the \(SO(p)_2\) and rank two Heisenberg Weil families that test whether the \(k=4\) switch is a law or an accident; a conductor deformation functor; a Clifford/Weyl workload IR; a Lean nucleus. Scope: first family only; matched dimensions, not a ring isomorphism.
